findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "finance?via=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: capital_call_collection_chasing, card_dispute_outcome_table_win, agency_side_certificate_request, waterfall_and_distribution · Private data: spend_limit_check, transaction_audit, underpayment_audit_compare, card_skimmer_and_pos_tamper_checks, capital_call_collection_chasing, invoice_make, chemical_trade_credit_payment_days, card_dispute_outcome_table_win, agency_side_certificate_request, waterfall_and_distribution, lpa_and_subscription_agreement · Public sink: spend_limit_check, transaction_audit, underpayment_audit_compare, card_skimmer_and_pos_tamper_checks, capital_call_collection_chasing, invoice_make, vat_number_check, chemical_trade_credit_payment_days, card_dispute_outcome_table_win, agency_side_certificate_request, waterfall_and_distribution, lpa_and_subscription_agreement.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
